facts.fact: StackAdapt published the article 'B2C and B2B digital marketing: What's the difference?' on July 20, 2023.
B2C marketing is focused directly on the consumer purchasing a company's product or service, according to StackAdapt's blog FAQ.
facts.quote: B2C marketing is focused directly on the consumer purchasing your product or service.

facts.fact: B2B marketing campaigns focus on individuals or teams that make purchasing decisions for a larger organization, according to StackAdapt's blog FAQ.
facts.quote: B2B marketing campaigns focus on individuals or teams that make purchasing decisions for a larger organization.

facts.fact: The page states that the main difference between B2C and B2B marketing is the target audience, so each requires different approaches to be effective.
facts.quote: The difference between B2C and B2B marketing is the target audience.

facts.fact: The page gives as an example of B2B marketing a company that sells email marketing tools to digital marketing agencies.
facts.quote: An example of B2B marketing is when a company sells email marketing tools to digital marketing agencies.

facts.fact: The page gives as an example of B2C marketing an auto dealership selling vehicles to an individual consumer or a family.
facts.quote: An example of B2C marketing is when an auto dealership sells vehicles to an individual consumer or a family.

facts.fact: The page cites healthcare technology companies as an example of hybrid B2B and B2C marketing because they may sell glucose monitors and blood pressure monitors directly to consumers while also serving hospitals.
facts.quote: Simultaneously, they may also sell personal tools like glucose monitors and blood pressure monitors, more directly to consumers.
